scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: At [04:06]-[05:02] (46s gap) and [07:13]-[08:21] (58s gap), the agent left the customer in unannounced dead air after saying only 'Wait a minute' and 'Hold on', and failed to thank the customer for waiting upon return.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: The agent never addressed the customer by his name (Zbigniew) at any point during the call after the customer introduced himself at [00:12].

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At [01:09] and [06:35], when the customer explained that £132 had been wrongly taken after cancellation and left him short on rent, the agent showed zero empathy or apology.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: At [01:26], after the customer explained the post-cancellation billing and router return issue, the agent failed to paraphrase or summarize the customer's problem in his own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: At [06:49], the agent asked how much the monthly charge was, even though the customer had already stated £44 per month twice at [00:12] and [03:24].

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [09:10]-[10:07] and [12:50]-[14:59], the agent refused ownership of the stuck billing token, declined to log notes or raise an internal ticket, and told the customer to call or write to another department himself.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At [11:03], the agent made a sarcastic, confrontational remark ('Raising your voice at me isn't going to make the money appear in your bank account any faster, is it?').

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: By [15:51]-[16:13], the £132 refund was not processed, the stuck recurring billing token remained active, and the customer was left with an unresolved billing error.

grader.scenario: Cancelled broadband account still being billed £44/month three months after returning router via Royal Mail Tracked
grader.notes: 8-FAIL very_poor call with hard-case PASSes on Branding ([00:00], [16:23]) and Probing ([01:53]-[03:40]) and hard-case FAILs on Hold/Dead Air ([04:06]-[05:02] 46s, [07:13]-[08:21] 58s), Ownership ([09:10]), and Rapport ([11:03]). Agent Callum never uses Zbigniew's name (P FAIL), shows zero empathy for £132 wrongly taken (E FAIL), never paraphrases (PA FAIL), re-asks the £44 monthly charge at [06:49] (AL FAIL), and leaves the refund unprocessed (RE FAIL).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent opens with 'thank you for calling S-Net' and [16:23]/[16:43] closes with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' despite poor service elsewhere.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [04:06] Agent says 'Wait a minute.' followed by a 46s unmanaged gap before [05:02], and [07:13] Agent says 'Hold on.' followed by a 58s unmanaged gap before [08:21] without announcing a hold or thanking the customer on return.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:31]-[00:58] Agent verifies the customer's previous address, four-digit PIN, and security question within the first minute.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:12] Customer introduces himself as Zbigniew, but the agent never uses his name in any turn.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:09] Customer reports £132 wrongly debited after contract cancellation and [06:35] explains it left him short on rent, with zero empathy from the agent across the call.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [00:12]-[01:26] Agent jumps directly from verification to probing questions without ever paraphrasing the customer's issue.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [00:12] and [03:24] Customer states S-Net billed £44/month, yet at [06:49] Agent asks 'How much is the monthly charge amount that has been coming out of your bank account?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [09:10] Agent says: 'Once an account is marked closed on our CRM, billing adjustments sit with the former-customer collections team—you'll have to write to them or ring their number.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [11:03] Agent snaps sarcastically: 'Raising your voice at me isn't going to make the money appear in your bank account any faster, is it?'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:53]-[03:40] Agent asks targeted diagnostic questions covering the cease completion date, disconnection reference, Royal Mail Tracked 48 barcode, warehouse delivery date, and exact Direct Debit transaction dates.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [08:42], [10:37], and [15:51] The £132 overcharge is not refunded and the recurring Direct Debit token remains scheduled to bill again.
